grammar-de-adv-dev-initial-vielleicht.explanation: The member-projection rule and one demonstration required lowercasing ordinary sentence-initial capitalization, but the instruction did not make the canonical lowercase projection sufficiently salient at the final decision point.

grammar-de-adv-dev-demonstrative-damit.explanation: The model preserved ordinary sentence-initial capitalization in normalizedMembers despite the route rule. This is the same prompt-level normalization defect as the Vielleicht miss.

grammar-de-adv-dev-cardinal-positive-vie.explanation: The case combined Degree Pos with a provisional NumType Card oracle for viel. Official UD German-GSD uses the ADV Card feature on 2x while ordinary viel is among feature-empty ADV forms, so the frozen case must be split into independent positive-degree and cardinal cases.

grammar-de-adv-dev-abbreviation-ca.explanation: The corpus expected Foreign null for abbreviation ca even though the prior ADV corpus oracle and an official German-GSD ADV attestation license Foreign Yes. The model followed the defensible foreign-Lemma analysis.

grammar-de-adv-dev-route-sconj-da.explanation: The model resolved the fixed ADV route correctly but preserved ordinary sentence-initial capitalization in normalizedMembers, the same prompt-level normalization defect as the other initial cases.

grammar-de-adv-dev-route-adp-davor.explanation: The model resolved the pronominal ADV identity and core feature correctly but preserved ordinary sentence-initial capitalization in normalizedMembers, the shared normalization prompt defect.
